slot_scores.name: missing_profit_maximization_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to maximize total weekly profit (with the 3000 yuan figure being a minimum-profit constraint), or is the objective to minimize total weekly cost while meeting a profit of at least 3000 yuan?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective and whether it is profit maximization.

slot_scores.name: missing_idle_time_minimization_objective
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about minimizing idle time or any secondary objective involving unused process capacity.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The only objective is to maximize weekly profit; idle time minimization is not part of the optimization.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about idle-time minimization or a secondary objective, but its READY_TO_MODEL summary lists only profit maximization and treats capacity constraints as simple upper bounds.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped at READY_TO_MODEL after resolving the P0 objective slot, but it never resolved the P1 idle-time minimization objective.

summary: The agent recovered the core profit-maximization objective and many constraint details, but it missed the P1 secondary objective of minimizing idle time with cost-proportional weights and silently assumed profit maximization was the only objective.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
